---
title: "Serial file sender"
subtitle: "Tools"
toc: false
---

Sends a local file as raw bytes over a Web Serial connection, with a progress bar. This is the useful 10% of a "programmer" that's generic across hardware: getting bytes out the USB port reliably. It does **not** implement any chip-specific flashing protocol (STK500, avrdude's protocols, DFU, ESP32's ROM bootloader handshake, and so on) — those are stateful protocols with their own framing and handshakes, specific to each target. What this covers is the common case underneath: a simple UART bootloader that just wants the raw image streamed in, or any other device where you need to push a known byte sequence out a serial port from the browser.

```{=html}
<div class="browser-note" id="browser-support-note">
Checking browser support…
</div>

<div class="tool-panel">
  <div class="tool-row">
    <span class="status-pill" id="status-pill"><span class="status-dot"></span><span id="status-text">Disconnected</span></span>
    <label for="baud-select">Baud</label>
    <select id="baud-select">
      <option>9600</option>
      <option>19200</option>
      <option>38400</option>
      <option>57600</option>
      <option selected>115200</option>
      <option>230400</option>
    </select>
    <button class="tool-btn" id="connect-btn">Connect</button>
    <button class="tool-btn" id="disconnect-btn" disabled>Disconnect</button>
  </div>

  <div class="tool-row">
    <input type="file" id="file-input" disabled>
    <label for="chunk-size">Chunk size (bytes)</label>
    <select id="chunk-size">
      <option value="64">64</option>
      <option value="128" selected>128</option>
      <option value="256">256</option>
      <option value="512">512</option>
    </select>
    <button class="tool-btn" id="send-btn" disabled>Send file</button>
  </div>

  <div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-bar-fill" id="progress-fill"></div></div>
  <div id="progress-text" style="font-size:12px;color:#5f5e5a;">No file sent yet.</div>

  <div class="terminal" id="terminal" style="height:160px;"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var terminalEl = document.getElementById("terminal");
  var statusPill = document.getElementById("status-pill");
  var statusText = document.getElementById("status-text");
  var connectBtn = document.getElementById("connect-btn");
  var disconnectBtn = document.getElementById("disconnect-btn");
  var fileInput = document.getElementById("file-input");
  var sendBtn = document.getElementById("send-btn");
  var baudSelect = document.getElementById("baud-select");
  var chunkSizeSelect = document.getElementById("chunk-size");
  var progressFill = document.getElementById("progress-fill");
  var progressText = document.getElementById("progress-text");
  var supportNote = document.getElementById("browser-support-note");

  var port = null;
  var selectedFile = null;

  function supported() {
    return "serial" in navigator;
  }

  if (supported()) {
    supportNote.textContent = "Web Serial is supported in this browser. Connect, choose a file, then send.";
  } else {
    supportNote.textContent = "This browser doesn't support the Web Serial API. Use desktop Chrome or Edge.";
    connectBtn.disabled = true;
  }

  function log(text) {
    terminalEl.textContent += text + "\n";
    terminalEl.scrollTop = terminalEl.scrollHeight;
  }

  function setConnected(isConnected) {
    connectBtn.disabled = isConnected;
    disconnectBtn.disabled = !isConnected;
    fileInput.disabled = !isConnected;
    sendBtn.disabled = !isConnected || !selectedFile;
    baudSelect.disabled = isConnected;
    statusText.textContent = isConnected ? "Connected" : "Disconnected";
    if (isConnected) {
      statusPill.classList.add("connected");
    } else {
      statusPill.classList.remove("connected");
    }
  }

  async function connect() {
    if (!supported()) return;
    try {
      port = await navigator.serial.requestPort();
      await port.open({ baudRate: parseInt(baudSelect.value, 10) });
      setConnected(true);
      log("[connected at " + baudSelect.value + " baud]");
    } catch (err) {
      log("[connect failed] " + err);
      port = null;
    }
  }

  async function disconnect() {
    try {
      if (port) {
        await port.close();
        port = null;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      log("[disconnect error] " + err);
    }
    setConnected(false);
    log("[disconnected]");
  }

  fileInput.addEventListener("change", function () {
    selectedFile = fileInput.files[0] || null;
    sendBtn.disabled = !port || !selectedFile;
    if (selectedFile) {
      progressText.textContent = selectedFile.name + " — " + selectedFile.size + " bytes, ready to send.";
    }
  });

  async function sendFile() {
    if (!port || !selectedFile) return;
    var writer = port.writable.getWriter();
    try {
      var buffer = await selectedFile.arrayBuffer();
      var bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
      var chunkSize = parseInt(chunkSizeSelect.value, 10);
      var sent = 0;
      log("[sending " + bytes.length + " bytes in " + chunkSize + "-byte chunks]");
      for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += chunkSize) {
        var chunk = bytes.slice(i, i + chunkSize);
        await writer.write(chunk);
        sent += chunk.length;
        var pct = Math.round((sent / bytes.length) * 100);
        progressFill.style.width = pct + "%";
        progressText.textContent = sent + " / " + bytes.length + " bytes sent (" + pct + "%)";
      }
      log("[done, " + sent + " bytes sent]");
    } catch (err) {
      log("[send error] " + err);
    } finally {
      writer.releaseLock();
    }
  }

  connectBtn.addEventListener("click", connect);
  disconnectBtn.addEventListener("click", disconnect);
  sendBtn.addEventListener("click", sendFile);
})();
</script>
```
